title: Implement internal reference request form + routing/approvals for Customer Reference Program
creator: Camila Reyes
project: Customer Reference Program (Case Studies + Reference Calls)
description:
We need a lightweight but enforceable internal workflow for requesting customer references (calls and/or public assets). Today requests are ad-hoc (Slack + email), which increases risk (surprise asks to customers, overuse of the same champions, missing legal permission, inconsistent logging).

This ticket implements:
1) A single intake entry point (form) for Sales/CS/Partnerships
2) Routing + required approvals (CSM + AE + Marketing owner + Legal when needed)
3) An SLA/lead-time expectation and a do-not-contact / cooldown guardrail
4) Tracking fields in HubSpot + a consistent place to log outcomes

Goal: make it easy for Sales to request references for active deals, while protecting customer relationships and ensuring we have proper consent for any quote/logo/metrics usage.

Links / source docs:
- Confluence: Customer reference program overview (policy/RACI): sources/confluence/sales-enablement/case-studies/customer-reference-program-overview.json
- Confluence: Reference intake + approval process (current draft): sources/confluence/sales-enablement/case-studies/customer-reference-intake-and-approval-process.json
- Drive: Reference call brief template: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/go-to-market/reference-call-brief-template.json
- Drive: Case study metrics and proof guide: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/go-to-market/case-study-metrics-and-proof-guide.json

Non-goals (for this ticket): building a customer-facing portal, automating scheduling end-to-end, or replacing existing deal desk workflows.

Open question: implement as (A) Google Form + Zapier/Make + Slack + HubSpot task creation, (B) HubSpot form + workflow automation, or (C) Airtable form + automations. Preference is lowest engineering effort with clear auditability.
acceptance_criteria:
Intake:
- Single URL to request a reference (call or public asset) that is easy to share in #sales and enablement docs.
- Form captures minimum required context to route correctly and avoid back-and-forth.

Approvals / routing:
- Requests auto-route to the account’s AE + CSM for review.
- Legal review is automatically required when request involves any of: customer logo, attributed quote, publishable metrics, case study publication, event/webinar recording.
- Marketing owner (Camila or delegate) must confirm (a) request is on-message and (b) we are not over-using a customer.

Guardrails:
- Enforces lead time guidance (target: 5 business days for new reference-call requests; 10+ business days if logo/quote/metrics are involved).
- Includes a cooldown policy field (e.g., “customer cannot exceed X reference calls/month”) and blocks requests that violate it unless explicitly escalated.
- Includes a ‘do not contact’ checkbox and requires justification when overridden.

Tracking:
- Creates/updates a HubSpot record (note/task/object) so utilization can be measured.
- Posts a structured message into a dedicated Slack channel (proposed: #customer-references) with request details + status.
- Includes a post-call completion step (outcome + deal influence + follow-ups).

Documentation:
- Confluence playbook updated with the final link, SLA, and example request.
- Sales enablement announcement message ready to send (copy + link).
proposed_form_fields:
Requester details:
- Requester name (auto if authenticated)
- Team (Sales / CS / Partnerships / Marketing)
- Slack handle + email

Deal / context:
- Deal stage (Discovery / Eval / Procurement / Final / Expansion)
- Prospect company name
- Deal ID / HubSpot deal link
- Target date for reference call (or deadline)
- Primary objective (security validation / performance proof / deployment model / cost / reliability)

Requested reference type:
- Reference call (live)
- Email reference (async Q&A)
- Public case study asset (web page)
- Quote-only (attributed)
- Logo-only

Requested customer:
- Preferred customer (if known)
- Alternative acceptable customer profile (industry, deployment mode)
- Must-match requirements (e.g., Private/VPC, HIPAA/BAA, EU data residency)

Messaging + boundaries:
- What you want the customer to emphasize (picklist aligned to messaging pillars)
- Topics to avoid (free text)
- Allowed artifacts requested (architecture diagram, metrics ranges, screenshots)

Approvals / risk:
- Does this request require logo/quote/metrics publication? (yes/no)
- NDA or confidentiality sensitivity known? (yes/no/unknown)
- Any known customer relationship risk? (free text)

Scheduling:
- Proposed time windows + timezone
- Number of attendees from prospect side

Post-call logging (required after completion):
- Completed? (yes/no)
- Outcome (helpful / neutral / negative)
- Follow-ups created (yes/no)
- Influence tag applied to deal? (yes/no) + notes
routing_logic_notes:
Routing principles:
- Default: CSM + AE must approve before any ask reaches the customer.
- Marketing approves the request and selects the best-fit reference customer (unless the requester specified a customer and it’s approved).
- Legal involved only when permissions extend beyond a private call (logo/quote/metrics/publication/event recording).

Routing implementation options:
Option A — Google Form + Zapier/Make:
- Pros: fast, flexible, low admin friction
- Cons: more brittle, governance/audit depends on setup discipline

Option B — HubSpot form + workflow:
- Pros: native logging, easier reporting, ties to deals/companies
- Cons: may require HubSpot admin time + careful workflow design

Option C — Airtable:
- Pros: strong workflow/status tracking, easy views
- Cons: yet another system; still needs HubSpot logging for reporting

Recommendation (as of 10/29): HubSpot form + workflow for intake + tracking, plus Slack notifications, with a simple fallback Google Form if HubSpot implementation slips.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (this ticket):
- Publish intake form + routing + Slack notifications
- Add minimum HubSpot properties/fields needed for reporting
- Update Confluence playbook + announce in #announcements

Phase 2 (follow-up):
- Add utilization dashboards (requests/month, call completion rate, influence on late-stage conversion)
- Build a reference customer ‘cooldown’ view (by customer) to prevent overuse
- Add an optional ‘auto-suggest best reference’ based on tags (deployment mode, industry, security) from the candidate shortlist
